subject: Re: Riverside advance - parking + guest list
body:
Hi Rhys,

Thanks for the advance sheet. Six crew parking passes for the weekend is no problem. We can also do 10 guest list spots for Saturday.

Stage plot received, thanks.

Sam

subject: Confirming what we agreed on the phone
body:
Hi Tess,

Lovely to chat. Confirming what we agreed on the phone: 4 parking passes for Marlo's party, and the Stage B green room is yours from 5:30pm to 7pm on Saturday so Marlo has a quiet hour before the set. I've also put you down for 6 guests on Saturday.

Priya

subject: Re: a couple of asks
body:
Kia ora Anahera,

Yes to all of it. Five parking passes are sorted for the band and crew. And I've spoken to the stage team, you can have a 75 minute set on Sunday, the crowd will love it. Eight guest list spots for Sunday are yours too.

Priya

subject: Performance agreement - Schedule A (excerpt)
body:
SCHEDULE A - PERFORMANCE

Artist: Kiri & the Tide
Stage: Stage A, Sunday 13 December 2026

3.1 The Promoter will provide the Artist a performance slot of 60 minutes, inclusive of changeover.
3.2 Soundcheck by arrangement with the Production Manager.

Signed for Fieldday Events: S. Okafor, Production Manager

subject: Riverside - you're in
body:
G'day Joe,

Good news. You've got three parking passes for the ute, the trailer tow and the cool van. I've allocated you two 32A outlets on vendor row for the smokers and the cold room. Load-in is Thursday 10 December, you're booked into Gate 2 from 7:30am to 8:30am. I'll also have 30 bags of ice set aside for you on Saturday.

Cheers,
Dan

subject: Re: power and parking
body:
Hi Leon,

All approved: you have two parking passes and two 32A outlets for the fryers.

Dan

subject: Call with Gus, Tap & Barrel
body:
Call with Gus from Tap & Barrel, 2 Oct. Notes by Mei.

- Gus needs the bar truck and two keg vans on site. Told him four parking passes is fine.
- Load-in: told him Gate 2 is his from 7am to 8am Thursday 10 Dec, he needs the hard stand for the keg pallets.
- He asked about ice. Said Dan will come back to him on numbers.

subject: Following Mei's call
body:
Hi Gus,

Following Mei's call. Two 32A outlets for the glycol chillers are locked in. On ice, we'll supply 60 bags each day of the festival.

Dan

subject: Parking + load-in
body:
Hi Carla,

Three parking passes approved. Gate 2 load-in is yours 9am to 10am on Thursday 10 December. Bring the oven trailer in nose first.

Mei

subject: Re: power
body:
Carla, yes, two 32A outlets for the dough mixer and the fridge trailer, done.

Dan

subject: Re: Halfmoon Parade advance
body:
Hi Imogen,

All good on our side. Five parking passes for the band bus and crew cars. You'll have the Stage B green room from 6pm until 7:30pm on Saturday before your 8pm set. Eight on the guest list for Saturday.

Sam

subject: Welcome aboard
body:
Hey Ost,

Jo here. Stoked you're on the bill. Three parking passes, done, don't stress about it. See you in December.

Jo

subject: Thread: choir parking
body:
From: Priya Nair, 24 Sep
Hi Margaret, we can give the choir eight parking passes.

From: Margaret Doyle, 26 Sep
Thanks Priya. Most of us are coming by minibus now so we won't need that many.

From: Priya Nair, 26 Sep
Perfect, let's make it six parking passes then, and I'll release the other two.

subject: Call with Margaret, Saltbush Choir
body:
Call with Margaret (Saltbush Choir). Notes by Mei.

- Several choir members can't walk the distance from the car park to Stage B.
- Promised two buggies on Saturday to shuttle them.
- She'll send a list of names.

subject: Buggy for Saturday
body:
Hi Rhys,

One buggy is reserved for the band on Saturday for the run between the hotel drop-off and Stage A.

Priya

subject: Re: quick one
body:
Tess, quick one. Yes, Marlo can have a buggy on Saturday, I've booked one.

Priya

subject: Great to meet you
body:
Rhys,

Great to meet you at the showcase. On the catering question, half your crew being vegan is not a problem, we'll sort a vegan caterer for your crew for all three days. Leave it with us.

Jo

subject: Re: power + parking
body:
Hi Linh,

One 32A outlet is confirmed for your steamers. On parking, I'll check whether we can get you a pass, the lot is tight. No promises yet.

Dan

subject: Power confirmed
body:
Hi Wei,

You're confirmed for one 32A outlet.

Dan

subject: Power for the river path carts
body:
Hi both,

Sorting power for the two carts by the river path. Riverbend Coffee gets one 32A outlet for the espresso machines, and Churro Cart gets one 32A outlet for the fryer.

Mei

subject: Re: freezers
body:
Ciao Franca,

The freezers are covered, I've put you down for two 32A outlets. And 20 bags of ice on Saturday for the display.

Sam

subject: Re: green room after the set
body:
Hi Ost,

Re the green room after your set, I might be able to get you the Stage B green room after 9pm on Saturday but I need to confirm with Sam first. Will let you know.

Priya

subject: Re: menu
body:
Hi Asha,

Thanks for the menu. Trading hours are 11am to 11pm each day and all vendors need to be set by 10am Friday. Nothing else needed from you this week.

Dan

subject: Noise curfew
body:
Sam, did the council come back on the noise curfew? Need it for the board update.

Jo

subject: Parking?
body:
Hi Dan,

Can we get 3 parking passes? We have the cart van, a supply car and my partner's car.

Thanks,
Rosa, Churro Cart
